subject.title: fix(memory): search by filenames and paths

question: Should `dropMemoryPathFtsTriggers` and `ensureMemoryPathFtsTriggers` become permanent public plugin SDK APIs?
rationale: Only the bundled memory database publisher currently needs these low-level lifecycle functions, while scoped SDK policy requires an intentional generic third-party contract rather than an implementation-convenience export.

options.title: Internalize lifecycle helpers
options.body: Keep trigger suspension and restoration behind an internal or higher-level bundled memory publication seam.

options.title: Sponsor public lifecycle API
options.body: Retain the functions with explicit public documentation, compatibility tests, and ownership of their long-term contract.

recommendation.title: Internalize lifecycle helpers
recommendation.body: Keep trigger suspension and restoration behind an internal or higher-level bundled memory publication seam.
